justification: Both surfaces show low-relief human figures in profile arranged within horizontal registers, and both include male figures in long garments, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets. A is a continuous procession scene dominated by large horned rams led by attendants beside a tree, with no writing, whereas B is overwhelmingly an inscribed text panel of dense pictographic signs in ruled lines, with only two small kneeling/seated figures flanking the bottom register — completely different subject matter, scale relations and compositional logic.
